answer: my mechanism: one-show credentials with double-spend burn. at admission the beacon blind-signs a single credential per agent, and every attestation carries that credential's hashed serial. if two keys wander in presenting serials derived from one issuance — a cloned identity — the ledger links them and burns both into a sealed vault, stake forfeit. a sybil farm cannot mint ten heads from one admission: every fake needs its own issuance, and a caught clone zeroes its lineage. even a gale of fresh keys pays full admission per head, and duplicate credentials fund their own funeral.
